retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic, desaturated mountain landscape framed by a dark border with large, textured serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a central rectangular landscape of misty, desaturated mountains under a cloudy sky, encased in a thick charcoal-grey border. The top section contains large, weathered serif text, while the bottom features a smaller, clean serif credit line, all unified by a heavy layer of film grain and dust speckles.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-to-image framing where the border acts as a stage for typography
Contrast between the organic mountain textures and the sharp geometric border
Desaturated color palette creating a somber, epic mood
Uniform film grain texture across both image and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Thick dark border framing the central image
High-contrast serif typography with distressed texture
Heavy film grain and dust artifacts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central rectangular landscape occupies the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large title text in the upper third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large top text, move down to the mountain range, and finish at the smaller text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The thick charcoal border provides significant negative space for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Charcoal grey and deep blacks in the border and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/light grey for the typography and sky highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted purples and browns within the mountain shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the text and the dark background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Distressed, chalky texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'K' has a high waist and sharp terminals
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scale and tracking of the same serif family for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Classical proportions and sharp serifs suitable for epic themes
The industry standard for cinematic serif typography

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a desaturated, cinematic landscape of misty mountains under a cloudy sky. Apply a heavy film grain and dust texture. Frame the image with a thick, dark charcoal-grey border on all sides, leaving more space at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, uppercase serif text in the top border area with a weathered, chalky texture. Add smaller, centered, uppercase serif text in the bottom border area with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain consistent across the image and border?
Is the color palette desaturated and moody?
Is the main title text significantly larger than the bottom text?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Exact mountain silhouettes from the source
Unique distressed patterns in the letters
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark background
Verify the 'weathered' texture on the text looks organic
Check that the landscape feels vast and epic
Confirm the square aspect ratio is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Epic Landscape + Dark Border Frame + Textured Serif Typography + Film Grain Overlay
